name: b attr write after method call
code:
class P:
    def __init__(self, v):
        self.v = v
        self.n = None
    def touch(self):
        self.v = self.v + 1
p = P(1)
q = P(9)
p.touch()
p.n = q
print(p.v, p.n.v, q.v)

d two attrs two ctor writes
code:
class P:
    def __init__(self, v):
        self.v = v
        self.l = None
        self.r = None
p = P(5)
p.l = P(3)
p.r = P(8)
p.l.n = P(1)
print(p.v, p.l.v, p.r.v, p.l.n.v)
